intro.title: learn and study
intro.note: Both words are *učit se*. **study** is the work. **learn** is the result. I **study** every evening, and I **learn** a lot.
intro.note_cz: Obojí je *učit se*. **study** = ta práce. **learn** = výsledek.

intro.title: learn and teach
intro.note: The student **learns**. The teacher **teaches**. Never ~~I learn him~~ → **I teach him**.
intro.note_cz: *Učit se* = **learn**. *Učit někoho* = **teach**. Nikdy ~~I learn him~~ → **I teach him**.

intro.title: You will use these words in
intro.note: **learn** and **study** are both *učit se*. **teach** is *učit někoho*.
intro.note_cz: learn a study = učit se. teach = učit někoho.
